items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Walter Johnson and I went with Robert -- Bobby Brown... Bobby Brown had a nice group over there.

ctx.x: Well, let's just watch what, with Mamie Smith (unintelligible) 1924 -- oh, did summer season at Asbury Park, who was that with?
Oh, that was with -- Walter Johnson and I went with Robert -- Bobby Brown, a fellow from Newark, New Jersey, saxophone player.
Oh, Bobby -- what did he play, alto?
